== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-top-8-bryan-mischke-ls-watch-your-step/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds T8 Mischke LS WYS.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114004544/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-top-8-bryan-mischke-ls-watch-your-step.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>00911e7c9b98ce10a903f246e9e0bd8fc6905af64d0bd1a38a6f9e2a37f4f393</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Moving To Attack Position (PC Errata)]] (<nowiki>4_57</nowiki>, gameText): engine reference <nowiki>Target one starfighter participating in a battle at a system or sector. For remainder of turn, starfighter may not move, is immune to attrition and, if piloted by any Corellian, is power +2.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>Target one starfighter participating in a battle at a system or sector. For remainder of turn, starfighter may not move, is immune to attrition and, if piloted by a Corellian, is power +2.</nowiki>.
